parsed.post: My latest experiment (1.1148) was a regression compared to my best (1.0464). Reverting to 4952c54. It seems the jump in LR or instability from the recent changes was too high. Next, I'll try a more conservative increase in MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.06 or 0.07, keeping WARMUP_RATIO=0.1.
parsed.description: Small incremental increase of MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.06 to find the optimal learning rate without causing instability.
